Close-up shots follow, showing the textured inner fillings of matcha and strawberry chocolate squares. (3) A close-up shows a bubbling beef hot pot at a Yoshinoya restaurant. Later, the same woman is seen sitting in a bright vehicle, drinking from the corn soup can while looking out the window. (8) A final sequence shows refrigerated shelves in a convenience store stocked with bottled teas and coffees, specifically focusing on the bottom rows with orange-capped bottles labeled as hot drinks.
